h_desc: 0 is the default head anchor. Negative moves left; positive moves right. The range is about one body width each way. Apply to save.
v_desc: 0 is the default head anchor. Negative moves down; positive moves up. The range is about two head heights each way. Apply to save.
size_desc: 50–300%; 100% is the default size. The icon remains attached to your Helldiver's head.
vol_desc: Controls only this mod's warning sound. 0 mutes it. Apply to save.
sound_desc: Select Play once, then Apply to hear the saved volume. Repeat whenever needed.
anim_desc: Apply and close the menu. After 3 seconds, the icon appears above your Helldiver and the warning sound plays.
reset_desc: Apply to enable every attack, reset position to 0, both Harvester delays to 0.30 seconds, size to 100% and volume to 60. Pending alerts and previews are cancelled.
delay_desc: Delay this attack's icon and sound by 0–0.5 seconds in 0.01-second steps; default 0.30 seconds. 0 keeps the original timing. Cancellation, a target change or death cancels the pending alert. Apply to save.
attack_desc: Warn when this enemy prepares this attack while targeting you. No distance limit.
crusher_desc: Warn for the Crusher's Heavy Cudgel attacks. Stomps are excluded.
dragon_desc: Alchemical Pyrosis during diving runs only. Hovering fire is excluded.
barrager_desc: Only direct-fire rockets trigger the warning. High-arc bombardment is excluded.
move.spore_titan_cataclysmic_slam: Spore Burst Bile Titan · Cataclysmic Slam
move.reinforced_heavy_rockets: Reinforced Scout Strider · Heavy HE Rockets
move.jet_hulk_rotary_saw: Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher · Heavy Rotary Saw
